schema.title: Prometheus Rules Test File

description:
The test suite is set to run with a one‑minute evaluation interval, and the groups will be evaluated in the order `example_group`. All rule files matching the pattern `rules/*.yaml` are included in the test run.

Within the **example_group** test group we evaluate every five minutes. The input series for this group are:
- `http_requests_total{method="GET",handler="/api"}` with the value pattern `0+1x5` (starting at 0 and then five increments of 1);
- `cpu_usage_seconds_total{cpu="0"}` with the value pattern `10+5x3` (starting at 10 and then three increments of 5).

At the three‑minute mark we verify the alert **HighRequestLatency**. The expected alert carries the labels `alertname="HighRequestLatency"`, `severity="critical"` and `instance="server01"`, and includes the annotations `summary="Request latency is high"` and `description="The 95th percentile latency exceeded threshold"`.

We also run a PromQL expression test at the same three‑minute evaluation time. The expression `sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))` is expected to produce a single sample whose label set is exactly `sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))` and whose value should be 42.5.

For the alert template, the external label `environment="staging"` is provided, and the external URL is set to `http://alertmanager.example.com`.
